lines.text: King Zedekiah sends Pashhur and the priest Zephaniah to ask Jeremiah to inquire of the LORD about Nebuchadnezzar's war.
The LORD says He will turn the weapons in their hands against them and strike down the city with a plague.
Whoever goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans will live, but the king of Babylon will destroy the city with a flood.
The LORD tells the king to do no wrong to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the priests.
Many nations ask why the LORD did this, and people answer that they forsook His covenant and served other gods.
